title: Document and metadata
summary: Give the browser a standards-mode document, language, title, encoding, and mobile viewport.
syntax:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="language">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Page title</title>
</head>
<body>Content</body>
</html>
<base href="/directory/">
<html lang="language" dir="rtl|ltr">
rules: The doctype selects standards mode; it is not an element.
Set lang to the document language and use a descriptive title.
A viewport declaration lets responsive CSS use the device width.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.
The first base href sets URL resolution; language and direction are independent.

title: Stylesheets and scripts
summary: Attach CSS and JavaScript to a document without blocking HTML parsing unnecessarily.
syntax:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="path.css">
<script type="module" src="path.js"></script>
<script defer src="classic.js"></script>
<script async src="independent.js"></script>
<script type="module">/* await import with try/catch */</script>
rules: Module scripts defer by default; defer applies to external classic scripts.
Resolve relative URLs against the document URL (or a base element).
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.
External classic defer preserves order; async executes when ready. Handle dynamic import rejection explicitly.

title: Semantic page regions
summary: Express the purpose of page regions using native landmarks and headings.
syntax:
Introduction
Links

Heading

Content
Related content
Credits
rules: Use one visible main region for the main content.
Choose article for self-contained content and section for a named thematic grouping.
Use headings in a meaningful hierarchy rather than choosing levels for appearance.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Text and inline meaning
summary: Mark paragraphs, headings, emphasis, and code according to their meaning.
syntax:
Heading

Text with stress and importance.

preserved whitespace
< > & Readable time Label

Quotation
rules: Escape literal < and & in text as character references when needed.
Use CSS for appearance; strong and em carry semantic meaning.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.
time datetime carries machine time; data value carries an identifier. cite names a work; blockquote cite is metadata, not a link.

title: Links and downloads
summary: Navigate to documents, sections, email addresses, or downloadable files.
syntax: Descriptive text Section Download New tab
rules: Use links for navigation and buttons for actions.
A fragment targets an element with a matching unique id.
download is primarily available for same-origin, blob, and data URLs.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Lists and descriptions
summary: Group sequences, unordered items, or term-description pairs.
syntax:
• Item
  1. Step
Term
Description
rules: Use ol when order matters and ul otherwise.
Place list items inside ul or ol; pair dt terms with dd descriptions in dl.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Images and responsive sources
summary: Embed images with alternatives, dimensions, and optionally responsive source selection.
rules: Describe informative images; use alt="" for purely decorative images.
Width and height reserve space to reduce layout shifts.
Width-descriptor srcset needs sizes to describe the rendered width.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Accessible data tables
summary: Arrange tabular data with captions and associated headers.
syntax:
Purpose
Column
Value
Group Value
rules: Use tables for data relationships rather than page layout.
scope="col" or "row" associates simple headers with their cells.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.
For grouped headers use unique th IDs and space-separated headers on each cell; caption names the table.

title: Forms and labels
summary: Collect named control values and submit them to a URL.
syntax:
<form action="URL" method="get|post">
  <label for="id">Label</label>
  <input id="id" name="key">
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
rules: Match label for to a unique control id; name determines the submitted key.
GET places data in the URL; POST sends a body. A server must handle real submissions.
Use fieldset and legend to label related controls.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Input types and validation
summary: Use native input types and constraints to guide data entry.
syntax:
<input type="email" name="key" required autocomplete="email">
<input type="number" min="number" max="number" step="number">
<input type="checkbox" name="key" value="value">
rules: Boolean attributes are enabled by their presence; required="false" still requires a value.
Client-side validation helps users but never replaces server-side validation.
Unchecked checkboxes are omitted from submission.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Selects and multiline text
summary: Offer predefined choices or a multiline text value.
syntax:
<select name="key"><option value="value">Label</option></select>
<textarea name="key" rows="number">Initial value</textarea>
rules: An option value is submitted; its text is the visible label.
Textarea initial content goes between its tags, not in a value attribute.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Buttons and disabled state
summary: Use native buttons for actions with an explicit behavior inside forms.
syntax:
<button type="button">Action</button>
<button type="submit">Submit</button>
<button type="reset">Reset</button>
<button type="button" disabled>Unavailable</button>
rules: A button inside a form defaults to submit; specify type for other actions.
disabled controls cannot be focused or submitted; explain why an action is unavailable.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Disclosure widgets
summary: Provide expandable information using a native disclosure control.
syntax:
<details open>
  <summary>Label</summary>
  Content
</details>
rules: The first summary labels the toggle; do not nest interactive controls in it.
open is a boolean attribute; omit it for an initially closed disclosure.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Accessible names and status
summary: Augment native semantics with accessible names, descriptions, or live announcements.
syntax:
Help

Status
rules: Prefer native HTML semantics before adding ARIA; ARIA does not add keyboard behavior.
aria-label overrides a native accessible name; visible text is often better.
A status region politely announces updates made after it exists in the DOM.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Global attributes and data
summary: Identify elements, attach style hooks, and store application-specific data.
syntax: <element id="unique" class="token token" data-key="value" hidden>Content</element>
rules: An id must be unique in its document; class is a whitespace-separated token list.
data-* values are strings exposed through dataset in JavaScript.
hidden hides content from normal rendering and accessibility APIs; it is not authorization.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.

title: Bootstrap components
summary: Combine Bootstrap 5.3 component classes with semantic HTML.
syntax:
Message
Content
Error text
Current
rules: Load Bootstrap 5.3 CSS in the host page; the extension does not bundle it.
Buttons and alerts shown here need no Bootstrap JavaScript; interactive plugins may need its bundle.
Do not communicate status through color alone.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.
Pinned Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS; validation appearance needs was-validated or is-invalid, native constraints still apply. details needs no library JavaScript.

title: Tailwind utilities
summary: Build responsive designs with generated Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes.
syntax:
<element class="utility hover:utility focus-visible:utility md:utility">Content</element>
<input required class="invalid:border-red-600 focus-visible:outline-2">
<details class="border p-4"><summary>Disclosure</summary></details>
rules: Compile Tailwind 4 with its CLI or build integration; utilities are not browser-native classes.
Use complete static class names so the scanner can detect them.
Unprefixed utilities apply at all widths; md: applies from the medium breakpoint upward.
HTML Living Standard; browser behavior verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium.
Pinned Tailwind 4.3.3 compiler scans exact HTML catalog classes; utilities do not add validation, names or roles.

title: Labels, groups and suggestions
summary: Give related controls a shared name while keeping individual labels and optional suggestions.
syntax:
<fieldset><legend>Group name</legend>
<label for="control">Label</label><input id="control" list="suggestions">
<datalist id="suggestions"><option value="suggestion"></datalist>
</fieldset>
rules: A legend names the fieldset, not its individual controls.
Datalist suggests values; use select when only listed values are permitted.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Autocomplete and input hints
summary: Suggest keyboards and autofill purposes without confusing hints with validation.
syntax:
<input autocomplete="section-name shipping postal-code" inputmode="numeric">
<input autocomplete="one-time-code" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{6}">
rules: inputmode does not enforce a numeric value; pattern does.
Use text for codes whose leading zero matters. Autofill availability depends on browser/user settings.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Readonly and disabled submission
summary: Choose whether a value is editable, focusable, validated and submitted.
syntax:
<input name="key" value="value" readonly>
<fieldset disabled><legend>Group</legend><input name="ignored"></fieldset>
rules: Readonly text controls are submitted but barred from constraint validation.
Disabled controls are omitted from FormData; the first legend has a fieldset exception.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Multipart file upload
summary: Encode real file fields with multipart POST and leave security validation to the server.
syntax:
<form method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" action="/upload">
<label for="file">File</label><input id="file" name="file" type="file" accept="image/*">
<button>Upload</button></form>
rules: accept filters the chooser; it does not validate content or MIME type.
Use POST multipart for file bodies; validate size, type and filename server-side.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Native validation and feedback
summary: Use browser validity plus explicit text errors; clear custom errors after correction.
syntax: Constraint
rules: Client validation improves feedback; it never replaces server validation.
Custom errors remain until setCustomValidity(""); associate visible errors and aria-invalid.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Modal dialogs and focus restoration
summary: Open a native modal, name it, and return focus to the invoking control.
syntax: Title
rules: showModal() makes the outside document inert; open alone creates a nonmodal dialog.
Escape requests cancel; method=dialog closes without network submission. Explicitly restore the invoker when it remains available.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Native popover disclosure
summary: Attach a nonmodal disclosure to a button with native dismissal behavior.
syntax: Details
rules: Auto popovers light-dismiss and close on Escape; manual popovers need an explicit close control.
Popover supplies visibility, not a menu role, modal behavior or an accessible name for arbitrary content. Requires Popover API support.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Picture and responsive sources
summary: Choose art direction with picture, or resolution with width descriptors and sizes.
rules: Keep a usable img fallback with alt; source has no alt.
Width descriptors describe actual intrinsic widths. sizes expresses layout, not file width; browser selection may vary with cache and density.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Audio, video and timed text
summary: Expose native controls, local media alternatives and correctly typed caption tracks.
syntax: Transcript
rules: Fallback children appear in browsers without media-element support; decode failures need a visible separate message.
Captions include relevant sounds; subtitles translate speech. Avoid autoplay assumptions and provide a transcript.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.

title: Named sandboxed frames
summary: Name embedded content and start with a restricted sandbox, granting only needed capabilities.
syntax:
<iframe title="Preview" sandbox srcdoc="<p>Preview</p>"></iframe>
<iframe title="Interactive preview" sandbox="allow-scripts" src="local.html"></iframe>
rules: Empty sandbox blocks scripts and gives an opaque origin; allow-scripts alone retains origin isolation.
Combining allow-scripts and allow-same-origin for same-origin content can defeat isolation. Escape untrusted srcdoc; sandbox does not sanitize HTML or prevent all requests.
Targets the HTML Living Standard; verified with the pinned Playwright Chromium in playground/web.
